C1512.title: A Mixed-Methods Investigation of XR Security Warnings—Lessons Learned
C1512.summary: A study investigated how users perceive and respond to in-headset security warnings within immersive XR environments. It found that alerts triggered during denial-of-service (DoS) attacks affect whether users can understand the risk, leave the disrupted scene, and reduce attack impact on performance and health.
